text.en:
The first paragraph of article three hundred and twenty of the Civil Code in force in the
Philippine Islands is hereby amended to read as follows:
"ACT. 320. Majority commences on attaining twenty-one years of age."

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, May 10, 1909.
